g.text: K6: ping-pong, two consumer warpgroups on two Q tiles, one KV stream
each K_j, V_j tile is loaded once and read by both consumers; a slot frees when both have released it.
the ordering barrier (PipelineOrder, 2 groups) makes the WGMMA issue alternate A, B, A, B. While one warpgroup's GEMMs run, the other is in
its softmax on the FP32 and SFU units. Both pipelines are complete; they are offset in time. Idle gaps appear when a softmax outlasts the other GEMM.
CTA: 384 threads = 3 warpgroups, 2 Q tiles (128 rows), grid halved in M. Registers: 128 x 24 + 256 x 240 = 64512 of 65536.
SMEM at d = 128: 2 Q stages (32 KB) + 5 KV stages (160 KB) = 192 KB, one CTA per SM.
Causal: the producer loads the KV range of the later tile; the earlier tile sees its one extra tile fully masked, so both consumers stay in lockstep.
